description:
Search the Companies House register by company name or keyword.

Returns a paginated list of matching companies with name, number,
status, incorporation date, and registered address. SIC codes are not
reliably returned by search; use company_profile for SIC codes.
Use company_profile for the full record once you have the company
number. Re-call with start_index=next_start_index to fetch the
next page.

company_status / company_type are applied by this server: Companies
House's search endpoint ignores them. A filtered call scans upstream
pages until it has items_per_page matches or has examined
500 upstream results; if it stops at that cap, is_partial is true
and fewer items does not mean no more matches exist.

company_status.description: Only return companies with this status. Applied by this server (Companies House search ignores it); see filters_applied and is_partial. Omit to search all.

company_type.description: Only return companies of this Companies House type code. Applied by this server (Companies House search ignores it); see filters_applied and is_partial. Omit to search all.

items_per_page.description: Number of results to return (max 100). Default 20.

query.description: Company name or keyword to search for

name: company_search

outputSchema.description: Paginated result of a Companies House company search.

filtered_returned.description: Number of returned items that passed filters_applied (equal to `returned`; every returned item satisfies every applied filter).

filters_applied.description: Filters this server applied to the results, e.g. {'company_status': 'active'}. Empty when none were requested. Companies House ignores status/type on this endpoint, so the server filters each upstream page itself.

has_more.description: True if upstream results remain beyond this page. Re-call with start_index=next_start_index to fetch the next page.

is_partial.description: True when filtering stopped at the per-call cap of 500 scanned results before finding items_per_page matches and before reaching the end of the upstream results. Fewer items does NOT mean no more matches exist: re-call with start_index=next_start_index to keep scanning.

items.description: Matching companies. Use the `company_number` field to call company_profile, company_officers, or company_psc for full detail.
A single entry in a Companies House search result.

address.description: Registered office address as returned by the Companies House API.

description.description: Short upstream description (usually number + status + creation date).

sic_codes.description: Standard Industrial Classification codes associated with the company.

items_per_page.description: Page size requested from the API for this call.

next_start_index.description: Upstream offset to pass as start_index for the next page, or null when the upstream results are exhausted. With filters this is NOT start_index+items_per_page, because non-matching results are skipped.

partial_reason.description: Why the result is partial, when is_partial is true.

query.description: The query string that was searched.

returned.description: Number of items actually returned on this page.

start_index.description: Number of results skipped before this page (upstream start_index).

total_results.description: Companies House's total for the query BEFORE any status/type filter (same as upstream_total, kept for compatibility). Not a count of filtered matches.

upstream_scanned.description: Upstream search results examined to build this page.

upstream_total.description: Total results Companies House reports for the query text alone. /search/companies cannot filter by status or type, so this is unfiltered.

title: Search Companies House
